description: This file defines the CategoricalColorNamespace class and related functions for managing color schemes and color assignments within namespaces, used in the superset UI core package.

classes.name: CategoricalColorNamespace
classes.description: Manages color scales and forced color items within a namespace, allowing retrieval and setting of colors for categorical data.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CategoricalColorScale instance based on the specified color scheme.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Enforces a specific color for a given value across all scales in the namespace.

methods.name: resetColors
methods.description: Resets all forced color items in the namespace.

methods.name: resetColorsForLabels
methods.description: Removes forced colors for specified labels.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CategoricalColorNamespace instance by name.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Gets a color for a value within a specified namespace and color scheme.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns a new scale instance within the same namespace, useful during chart initialization.
